comparison.objective: Replace a frayed USB cable in the same hub port; unlike shock-absorber commissioning.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual hub counterholding, straight connector extraction, same-port alignment, and full insertion. Shared stabilization/insertion primitives are generic.
comparison.success_condition: Old plug removed and binned before new plug leaves dock; new plug fully inserted only into the original port; arms return. Force/tolerance details and spec versions are absent.
comparison.reason: Tests connector replacement and strict sequencing, not fine rotary adjustment or repeated impact validation.
